title: FR3-DUALIS: from signal processing to spectrum allocation for real-time wideband full-duplex ISAC—a prototype validation at FR3
task: Demonstrate wideband dual-band full-duplex ISAC prototype with frequency-separated spectrum allocation and real-time processing constraints
key_results: BER = 0 on QPSK-OFDM frames at 24.25 GHz (communication) with simultaneous 25.175 GHz sensing (monostatic); Zadoff-Chu sequences improve PSLR/ISLR by 2.49/4.43 dB; real-time velocity tracking at 10 Hz with 0.21 m/s resolution
